passages.text: The end of the world can never be reached by traveling. But without reaching the end of the world, there’s no release from suffering.
passages.note: seeking escape outside oneself; suffering resolved within

passages.text: “Time flies, nights pass by, the stages of life leave us one by one. Seeing this peril in death, do good deeds that bring you joy.”
When a forest is burned by fire, a conflagration with a blackened trail, the shoots will spring up there again, with the passing of the days and nights.
